# gameLog.json Structure Guide

`data/gameLog.json` is the unified game source (about 21 MB, around 1,070 games, about 13,900 player rows). It is generated by `scripts/data-sync/` from AWS S3 logs merged with legacy Google Sheet data. Never edit it by hand, and never `view`/`cat` it whole. Statistics computation rules live in the `data-sync-statistics` skill; the roles/powers/gadgets reference lives in `data/gameReference.json` (`game-reference-update` skill).

Counts below are a snapshot (Oct 2026). Re-measure with the snippets at the end before relying on them.

## Files

| File | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `data/gameLog.json` | Main team. Game Ids start with `Ponce-`, `Tsuna-`, `khalen-` or `Meetozila-` |
| `data/discord/gameLog.json` | Discord team (`Nales-` Ids). Same game and player schema, but no `LegacyData` or `Clips` |
| `data/gameLog-Legacy.json` | Older Google Sheet export, not the runtime source |
| `data/joueurs.json` / `data/discord/joueurs.json` | `{ TotalRecords, Players: [{ Joueur, SteamID, Image, Twitch, Youtube, Couleur }] }`. Canonical player names by Steam ID |
| `data/gameReference.json` | Reference for roles, powers, gadgets and events |

The runtime TypeScript contract is in [useCombinedRawData.tsx](../../../src/hooks/useCombinedRawData.tsx) (`GameLogEntry`, `PlayerStat`, `Vote`, `Action`, `RoleChange`, `Clip`, `GameEvent`, `LegacyData`). `DeathType` constants are in `src/types/deathTypes.ts`.

## Top level

```
{ ModVersion, TotalRecords, Sources: { Legacy, AWS, AWSNew, AWSUpdated, ... }, LastSync, GameStats: GameLogEntry[] }
```

`GameStats` is in chronological order. `Sources` and `LastSync` are sync bookkeeping and are not used for statistics.

## Game (`GameStats[]`)

| Field | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| `Id` | Unique. Formats: `<Host>-<yyyyMMddHHmmss>` (modern AWS), `<Host>-<yyyyMMdd000000>-<n>` (legacy; `n` is the daily order). Host prefix = recorder, not necessarily the only player |
| `StartDate`, `EndDate` | ISO UTC. Legacy games have midnight `StartDate` (date-only precision) |
| `MapName` | `Village` (about 85 %), `Château`, `Donjon`, `Ashfang Woods (Village aux échecs)`, `Lupus Labs (Labo spatial)`, `Wisterio Lane (Villa mystère)` |
| `HarvestGoal`, `HarvestDone` | Loot target and amount collected. `HarvestDone >= HarvestGoal` means a harvest win |
| `EndTiming` | Last phase, e.g. `M3`, `N4`, `J5`. Never null in current data |
| `Version` | Mod version string (`0.2.4`, `0.14`, `0.344`...). Not semver, so compare numerically per segment |
| `Modded` | `false` only for the oldest versions (0.2.4 to 0.15.2). Pre-mod games have much less detail |
| `IsBattleRoyale` | Optional. `false` or absent in practice. Runtime hook drops games where it is `true` |
| `GameEvents` | Optional (from 25 Nov 2025). Phase and mayor timeline, see below |
| `Clips` | Optional. Twitch clips, main team only |
| `LegacyData` | Absent for the newest AWS-only games. See below |
| `PlayerStats` | 8 to 15 players per game (15 in about 43 %) |

`DisplayedId` (global chronological game number) is **not stored** in the file. `useCombinedRawData` and `compute-series-data.js` generate it at load time by sorting on the Id timestamp then trailing number. Do not search the raw file for it.

### `LegacyData`

`{ VictoryType, PlayerVODs, GameModId?, FullDataExported? }`

- `VictoryType` (French free text, only source for the winning mode): `Votes`, `Domination`, `Objectif solo réussi`, `Récolte`, `Tir du Chasseur`, `Potion assassin`, `Tué par Zombie`, `Tir du Shérif`, `Tué par Boule de Crystal`, `Mort de La Bête`, `Tir du Vengeur`, `Amoureux entretués`, `Avatar tué`, `Déco loup`, `Mort de faim`, `Mort du Loup ressuscité`, `Tué par Loup Devin`.
- `PlayerVODs`: `{ [playerId]: url }`. The key is the player `ID` (Steam ID, or short legacy id like `"11"`).
- `GameModId` and `FullDataExported` are present when the Google Sheet row was merged with mod data (about 470 games). `Actions` for those players come from the mod and have `Position`/`Date`.
- The TS interface mentions `LegacyData.PlayerStats`; it is not present in the current file.

### `GameEvents[]`

`{ Date, Timing, Type, Name }`. `Type` values:

| Type | `Name` |
| --- | --- |
| `NewPhase` | Phase code (`J1`, `N1`, `M1`...). Three per round: day, night, meeting |
| `NewMayor` | Player name (not ID). Mayor changes show up as repeated entries in one meeting |
| `DailyEventStart` | `Harvest`, `Haste`, `Fog`, `Plague`, `FullMoon`, `Tournament`, `Eclipse`, `Spellstorm`, `Rage`, `Vengeance` |
| `SabotageActive` | `WellPoison`, `Portals`, `WolvesRitual` |

### `Clips[]`

`{ ClipId, ClipUrl, ClipName, POVPlayer, OthersPlayers (comma-separated string), RelatedClips (comma-separated clip ids), NextClip, NewName, AdditionalInfo, Tags[] }`. Tags: `Moddé`, `Move Expert`, `Oupsi`, `Musical`, `Pas de chance`, `Warning Sonore`, `Chance`. `ClipId` is a string, unique across the whole file. `POVPlayer`/`OthersPlayers` use names, not IDs.

## Player (`PlayerStats[]`)

Always present: `ID`, `Username`, `Color`, `MainRoleInitial`, `MainRoleChanges`, `Power`, `SecondaryRole`, `DeathDateIrl`, `DeathTiming`, `DeathPosition`, `DeathType`, `KillerName`, `Victorious`, `Votes`.

| Field | Semantics |
| --- | --- |
| `ID` | Steam ID (17 digits) for modern rows. Legacy rows can have short ids (`"11"`, `"50"`). Always identify with `getPlayerId()` (`ID \|\| Username`), because the same person has several `Username` spellings (for example `Khalen`/`khalen`, `Mathy`/`MathyMoon`). A username never maps to more than one ID |
| `Username` | In-game name at that time. `joueurs.json` gives the canonical display name, applied at load time by `normalizeGameLogEntry` |
| `Color` | One of 12 French colors (Jaune, Bleu foncé, Orange, Rose, Rouge, Violet, Gris, Marron, Turquoise, Bleu royal, Vert pomme, Vert foncé) |
| `MainRoleInitial` | Role at game start (list below) |
| `MainRoleChanges` | `[{ NewMainRole, RoleChangeDateIrl? }]` in order. `NewMainRole` is `Zombie`, `Loup`, `Chasseur` or `Villageois`. Final role = last entry, via `getPlayerFinalRole()` |
| `Power` | Not only for `Villageois Élite`: villagers and wolves also carry a power (`Villageois` about 5,600 rows, `Loup` about 1,300). For `Villageois Élite` it is the effective role (`Chasseur`, `Alchimiste`, `Purificateur`, `Guetteur`, `Disciple`, `Protecteur`). `Inconnu` means unrecorded. `null` means no power |
| `SecondaryRole` | `null` for about 87 % of rows, otherwise one of about 28 values (`Téléporteur`, `Farceur`, `Coureur`, `Politicien`, `Shérif`, `Mage bleu`...). `Amoureux` is never here |
| `DeathTiming` | `null` if survived. Otherwise phase+number: `N2` night, `M2` meeting vote, `J3` day, `U1` unknown phase (rare, old games) |
| `DeathType` | `null` if survived (but see pitfalls). See below |
| `KillerName` | Name (not ID) of the killer. Set for wolf kills and killer-based deaths. Resolve through `compute/achievements/helpers.js` helpers, not by raw equality |
| `DeathDateIrl`, `DeathPosition` | Real date of death (modern games). `DeathPosition` is `{x,y,z}` or `null` |
| `Victorious` | Team result for that player. Always at least one winner per game. Solo roles win individually. `Amoureux` players can both be `false` |
| `Votes` | `[{ Day, Target, Date }]`. `Day` is the meeting number (1..8), **not a calendar day**. `Target` is a player name or `"Passé"` (abstention). `Date` is null for legacy |

Optional fields (check with `!== undefined`, not truthiness; `0` is valid):

| Field | Presence |
| --- | --- |
| `SecondsTalkedOutsideMeeting`, `SecondsTalkedDuringMeeting` | Absent on about 4 % of rows (oldest data) |
| `TotalCollectedLoot` | `null` or absent on legacy rows |
| `Actions` | Absent on about 53 % of rows (legacy without action data). `[]` is a legitimate empty list |
| `LegacyActionsIncomplete` | `true` on about 300 rows: Actions from the Google Sheet are known to be partial. Do not compute action counts or rates from these rows |
| `ActionsIncomplete` | Newer equivalent flag (`true` on about 130 rows) |
| `SecondsSpentImmobileStanding/Crouched`, `SecondsSpentWalkingStanding/Crouched`, `SecondsSpentRunning` | Only on about 4,400 recent rows (mod data) |
| `Hat` | Cosmetic id (about 5,200 rows) |
| `SkinIndex`, `SkinColorIndex` | Very rare (112 rows, always `0`) |

### `MainRoleInitial` values

`Villageois` (about 54 %), `Loup`, `Villageois Élite` (resolve with `Power`), `Chasseur`, `Alchimiste` (older standalone roles, now powers of `Villageois Élite`), `Idiot du Village`, `Agent`, `Amoureux Loup`, `Amoureux Villageois`, `Amoureux` (2 rows, old), `Espion`, `Scientifique`, `Vaudou`, `La Bête`, `Chasseur de primes`, `Kidnappeur`, `Cultiste`, `Mercenaire`, `Traître`, `Contrebandier`, `Louveteau`, `Cannibale`. `Zombie` appears only as a role change (camp `Vaudou`).

Use `getPlayerCampFromRole`/`getPlayerMainCampFromRole` in `src/utils/datasyncExport.js` for camp mapping; do not hand-roll it.

### `DeathType` values

`BY_WOLF`, `VOTED`, `SURVIVALIST_NOT_SAVED`, `BULLET_HUMAN`, `BULLET_WOLF`, `BULLET`, `BY_BEAST`, `BY_ZOMBIE`, `LOVER_DEATH`, `ASSASSIN`, `SEER`, `STARVATION`, `STARVATION_AS_BEAST`, `CRUSHED`, `BOMB`, `FALL`, `OTHER_AGENT`, `SHERIF_SUCCESS`, `SHERIF_MISTAKE`, `MOLE`, `AVENGER`, `VENGEANCE`, `HANTED`, `SMUGGLER_HUNT_KILL`, `SMUGGLER_LOOT_FAILURE`, `MERCENARY_HUNT_KILL`, `MERCENARY_LOOT_FAILURE`, `CULTIST_FAILED`, `KILLED_VILLAGE_IDIOT`, `BY_AVATAR_CHAIN`, `UNKNOWN`. Grouped constants (`WOLF_KILLS`, `HUNTER_KILLS`, `POTIONS`...) live in `src/types/deathTypes.ts`; use them instead of listing values.

### Timing codes

`<phase><number>`: `J` = day, `N` = night, `M` = meeting (vote), `U` = unknown. Order inside round *n*: `J<n>` → `N<n>` → `M<n>`. Use `parseTiming()` (`src/utils/wolfTransformUtils.ts` or `scripts/data-sync/shared/wolf-transform-utils.js`). Vote `Day` *n* matches meeting `M<n>`. A vote death at `M3` shows votes with `Day` 3.

## Actions (`PlayerStats[].Actions[]`)

`{ Date, Timing, Position, ActionType, ActionName, ActionTarget }`. `Date` and `Position` are `null` for Google Sheet legacy actions (about 10 % of actions).

| `ActionType` | `ActionName` | `ActionTarget` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `UseGadget` | Gadget: `Livre de sorts`, `Balle`, `Radar`, `Diamant`, `Bouteille incendiaire`, `Grenade`, `Fumigène`, `Verrou`, `Piège`, `Longue-vue`, `Clé`, `Parchemin (<effet>)`, `Gaz (<type>)` | Player name for targeted gadgets, else `null` |
| `DrinkPotion` | Potion effect (`Assassin`, `Invisible`, `Vampire`, ...). `Blanche - <effet>` = white (purified) variant | always `null` |
| `TakeAccessory` | `Boule de cristal` (also spelled `Boule de crystal` in older data), `Bottes de furtivité`, `Livre de sorts`, `Sac à dos`, `Anneau de vitesse`, `Loupe`, `Corne d'abondance` | `null` |
| `Transform` / `Untransform` | `null` (wolf form toggles) | `null` |
| `HunterShoot` | `null` | Shot player (can be `null`) |
| `Sabotage` | `Puit`, `Portail`, `Pillier rituel`, `Bûches`, `Chaudron`, or `null` | `null` |
| `TournamentWon` / `TournamentLost` | `null` (daily event `Tournament`, rare) | `null` |

Normalize variants (`Boule de crystal`/`cristal`, `Blanche - ` prefix, `Parchemin (...)` wrapper) before grouping by `ActionName`. Check `gameReference.json` for the canonical gadget/accessory names.

## Practical pitfalls

- Group per player by ID, never by `Username`, and match `KillerName`, `Votes[].Target`, `Actions[].ActionTarget` and `Clips[].POVPlayer` through the player-name helpers. They hold names (resolved in the `normalizeGameLogEntry` second pass), not IDs.
- `Victorious` is the source of truth for wins. Do not re-derive winners from `VictoryType` text.
- A survivor has `DeathType === null` and `DeathTiming === null`. About 15 rows have `DeathTiming` without `DeathType` and 5 the reverse. Filter on the field you actually use.
- Legacy and pre-mod games (`Modded: false`) lack positions, talk time, loot, actions, events, and sometimes IDs. Gate metrics on field availability or `Version`, and keep numerator and denominator on the same filtered set.
- Version gates: `GameEvents` start 2025-11-25 (`Ponce-20251125112953`); movement-time fields exist only on recent mod games.
- Discord data has no `Clips`/`LegacyData`; main-only features must be gated (`mainTeamOnly` in achievements).
- The newest synced games (Version `0.362`, AWS only) have no `LegacyData`: guard `game.LegacyData?.VictoryType`.

## Inspecting the file safely

Never open the whole file in an editor view or tool. Use Node (the file parses in about 1 s):

```powershell
@'
const g = JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('data/gameLog.json', 'utf8')).GameStats;
const game = g.find(x => x.Id === 'Ponce-20251125112953');
console.log(JSON.stringify(game.PlayerStats[0], null, 2));
'@ | node -
```

Useful patterns:

- Value distribution of a field: flatten `g.flatMap(x => x.PlayerStats)`, count with a `Map`, and print the top N.
- Key coverage: `ps.flatMap(p => Object.keys(p))` counted per key reveals optional fields.
- One game by Id: `grep -n '"Id": "<id>"'` on the file (pretty-printed, so each key is on its own line) and then `view` with a narrow `view_range`.
- Large or generated outputs (`playerRankings.json`, `playerStatsCache.json`, `playerTitles.json`, `playerAchievements.json`) are derived. Inspect them the same way and regenerate them with the `data-sync-statistics` commands instead of editing.

When the schema changes (new field, new enum value): update `GameLogEntry`/`PlayerStat` in `useCombinedRawData.tsx`, `src/types/deathTypes.ts` if relevant, and this skill's tables.
